intent: Technical Brief: System State Baseline for Acer Swift X
detected_fault: Backlight Bleed on bottom right corner of display panel
suggested_solution: Acer should investigate and address this design flaw to prevent similar issues in future models.
Users who experience backlight bleed on their Swift X laptops should contact Acer's support team for assistance and potential repair or replacement options.

Buyers should be aware of this potential issue when purchasing the Acer Swift X, and consider the following: Monitor usage patterns and adjust settings accordingly to minimize exposure to hot air. Regularly clean the laptop's vents to ensure proper airflow. Consider using a laptop stand or external cooling solution to reduce heat buildup.
